description:
[Admin]

Lists the folders of the company's media library with how many files each holds, empty folders included. Put a file in a folder with `folder` on media-upload-start or media-update; list one folder with media-list `folder`.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

name: List_the_media_library_folders

folders.description: A to Z, whatever the case. The top ("") is not a folder and is not listed.

files.description: Files in the folder that finished uploading.

name.description: Folder name, as files name it in `folder`.

title: Media Folders
